bibliography.title: Learning to Segment for Vehicle Routing Problems

sections.title: 5.1 L2Seg accelerates various iterative backbone solvers
5.2 L2Seg outperforms classic and neural baselines
5.3 L2Seg performs and generalized well on more realistic CVRP

abstract_sentences.text: Iterative heuristics are widely recognized as state-of-the-art for Vehicle Routing Problems (VRPs).

In this work, we exploit a critical observation: a large portion of the solution remains stable, i.e., unchanged across search iterations, causing redundant computations, especially for large-scale VRPs with long subtours.

evidence.anchor: a large portion of the solution remains stable

abstract_sentences.text: To address this, we pioneer the formal study of the First-Segment-Then-Aggregate (FSTA) decomposition technique to accelerate iterative solvers.
FSTA preserves stable solution segments during the search, aggregates nodes within each segment into fixed hypernodes, and focuses the search only on unstable portions.

evidence.anchor: aggregates nodes within each segment into fixed hypernodes

abstract_sentences.text: Yet, a key challenge lies in identifying which segments should be aggregated.

evidence.anchor: identifying which segments should be aggregated

abstract_sentences.text: To this end, we introduce Learning-to-Segment (L2Seg), a novel neural framework to intelligently differentiate potentially stable and unstable portions for FSTA decomposition.
We present three L2Seg variants: non-autoregressive (globally comprehensive but locally indiscriminate), autoregressive (locally refined but globally deficient), and their synergy.
Empirical results on CVRP and VRPTW show that L2Seg accelerates state-of-the-art solvers by 2x to 7x.
We further provide in-depth analysis showing why synergy achieves the best performance.

evidence.anchor: why synergy achieves the best performance

abstract_sentences.text: Notably, L2Seg is compatible with traditional, learning-based, and hybrid solvers, while supporting various VRPs.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 将迭代 VRP solver 中少数真正变化的 edges 识别为 unstable，FSTA 固定 stable segments 为 hypernodes 并只在 reduced problem 上搜索，L2Seg-SYN 再用 NAR 找 global regions、AR 做 local refinement。证据见 p.3–7、p.19、p.29。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留稳定性动机、FSTA segment/hypernode/recovery、两个 theorem 的陈述、共享 encoder 与三 decoder 的差异、lookahead labels、Table 1–5 主结果以及 Recall/TNR 机制证据。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承接完整 proofs、四变体 aggregation、feature/mask、training/inference algorithms、baseline/data/完整 hyperparameters、realistic/variance/overhead/training-time 结果。核心决策可读，但 VRPTW 时间窗、AR label 过滤、warm-start heuristic 不能只靠正文复现。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 2 将 FSTA 五步和三 decoder 对齐，Figure 3 将 encoder/NAR/AR 置于同一数据流，Algorithm 1 把循环落实为可执行接口，Table 4 把 global recall 与 local precision 的互补变成指标。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 2x–7x 是摘要/曲线 headline，不是每个固定时间表格单元的直接 speedup；label 依赖 lookahead solver，跨 solver 只做 overlap 分析；HGS 与未测试 variants 的兼容性仍是边界。Table 6 还排除了 oracle lookahead 时间。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 先证明聚合—展开保持可行性与目标顺序，再以 global detector 提供覆盖、conditional local refiner 控制过标，并把 warm-start/fixed-edge 写成 backbone contract。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 仅当 segment 约束可由有限 hypernode 表达、recovery 目标差为 segment-dependent constant、backbone 能使用 reduced warm start 且 label 分布接近部署 solver 时，这种 global-local synergy 才有本文含义。
